title: Men in Sunday Attire Gathering in Backyard, c. 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black and white snapshot capturing a casual outdoor gathering of men and boys in a grassy yard. Dressed in mid-century Sunday best—white collared shirts, neckties, and pleated trousers—they relax in the shade of a large catalpa tree and beside a brick residence. Some rest on the lawn leaning against the house foundation, while others chat near a wooden outbuilding and swing frame, embodying the quiet fellowship of post-WWII American family or church get-togethers.
